title: Madrid Residency Eve — 550,000 Fans Await Historic 10-Night Run at Riyadh Air Metropolitano Opening Tomorrow; Adidas Flamboyan Wide Release Also Tomorrow
detail: Bad Bunny stands on the eve of the most ambitious concert residency of his career. The 10-night DtMF World Tour run at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid opens tomorrow, May 30, 2026 — the largest single-artist stadium residency ever staged in Spain, projected to draw more than 550,000 fans across 10 sold-out shows spanning May 30 through June 15. Each night in the 70,000-capacity venue brings the full 360-degree DtMF World Tour production: the multi-level stage architecture, 'La Casita' intimate secondary platform, live musicians, dancers, and the rotating one-unique-song-per-night tradition. Madrid's transit authority and city council coordinated expanded metro and bus services, hotel groups reported near-100% occupancy citywide, and tour operators across Europe assembled package tours around the residency dates. The Billboard Pro piece on how Metropolitano is preparing — published days earlier — documented security coordination, parking protocols, and catering logistics at a scale not seen since a recent Champions League final. Alongside the opening night, May 30 marks the wide global release of the Bad Bunny x Adidas Ballerina 'Flamboyan' (KI7916, Vivid Red, $120) via the Adidas Confirmed app and select global retailers — a deliberate co-release that synchronizes the shoe launch with the Madrid debut. 'DtMF' approaches its 61st week at No. 1 on Billboard Hot Latin Songs (chart dated May 30 releases tomorrow), continuing the all-time chart record it established when it surpassed 'Despacito' at week 57 in late April 2026. The Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour, which has no U.S. dates in protest of ICE immigration enforcement, has now completed stadium runs in Latin America (nine countries), South Korea, Japan, Australia, the Dominican Republic, and Europe (Barcelona, Lisbon), with Madrid closing out what will be its longest single-city engagement.
